title: Government Notifies 11 Additional Ports for e-Visa Entry, Taking Total to 88 Ports
summary: Center notified 11 new international ports (9 land ports + 2 airports), expanding e-visa entry ports to 88 across India.

blocks.content: Center notified 11 new international ports (9 land ports + 2 airports), expanding e-visa entry ports to 88 across India.

items: **New Additions:** 11 ports = 9 land ports + 2 airports (**Bhopal and Tirupati**).
**Total e-Visa Ports:** Reached **88 ports** (37 Airports + 38 Seaports + 13 Land Ports).

blocks.summary: Nodal Ministry: Ministry of Home Affairs (Bureau of Immigration).
